title: Involvement and distinctions
exampleQuestions: Is he involved in any association?
answer: Since May 2026 Hamza is General Secretary of AEDI, the Computer Science student association. Since 2023 he holds an excellence scholarship from the Georges Besse Foundation, which supports him through his engineering studies. Since 2026 he is also a member of Propulseo, mentored by Asys, an HR software company, and he follows INSA Lyon's Entrepreneurship Track (2026 to 2027), a program on turning concrete problems into viable products.
